description: This file defines the core class 'ModelService' which represents a service in the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes fields for service metadata, parameters, permissions, and notifications, along with methods for validation, permission evaluation, parameter management, and interfacing with service groups. The class implements a generic map interface to expose its fields and provides mechanisms for default value assignment, validation, and permission checks, indicating it is central to the OFBiz service modeling architecture.

classes.name: ModelService
classes.description: This class models a service definition within the OFBiz framework, encapsulating metadata, parameters, permissions, notifications, and behaviors necessary for executing, validating, and managing services. It extends the AbstractMap class to expose its fields as a map, supports serialization, and includes methods for permission evaluation, validation, default value handling, parameter management, and interfacing with service groups.
